_about: Crafting costs by damage output. A gun whose damage a second (over a magazine and its reload) is outlier_from times the median of its Age or more needs a rare part, one more for each further step, at most max_units; Ages with fewer than min_peers guns are not judged. A recipe that already asks for one of rare_items is left as its author made it.
_attachments: Attachments that raise a gun's damage are not sold at the attachment table, except those of the gun packs listed here (by id namespace).
